content.text: The Full List With Context

1. **USDT on Tron Network**: Settles in under 60 seconds for fees under $0.10. Ideal for instant product delivery. 2. **Binance P2P**: Supports Ethiopian birr and 50+ currencies. Use it to convert crypto to local fiat. 3. **NOWPayments Crypto Invoicing**: Accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with 0.5% fee. No KYC required. 4. **Cloudflare R2 + IPFS**: Host digital products for free. Deliver globally without bandwidth fees. 5. **Google Apps Script Webhooks**: Automate order fulfillment for $0/month. 6. **Supabase Database**: Store orders and customer data for free. 7. **GitHub Pages Storefront**: Deploy a static store in minutes. Zero hosting costs.
Why Each Item on This List Matters

USDT on Tron solves the speed and cost problem that Ethereum and Bitcoin networks create. Binance P2P bridges the gap between crypto earnings and local currency needs. NOWPayments eliminates the dependency on buyer accounts or KYC processes. Cloudflare R2 and IPFS ensure your products are delivered globally without recurring costs. Google Apps Script removes backend servers entirely. Supabase provides a scalable database without subscriptions. GitHub Pages gives you a storefront that never goes down—or sends you a bill.
The Ones Most Creators Get Wrong

Many creators attempt PayPal or Stripe workarounds using VPNs. These fail at payout. Others rely on local mobile money systems that don't support international buyers. Some use centralized crypto exchanges with high withdrawal fees. The critical error is building on platforms that can revoke access. Sovereign infrastructure means owning the stack—not renting it. Avoid tools that require ongoing subscriptions or third-party approvals.
USDT on Tron settles faster than PayPal—for 1/100th the fee.
How to Prioritise What to Implement First

Start with USDT on Tron for payments. It's the fastest and cheapest way to accept international transactions. Next, deploy a GitHub Pages storefront with NOWPayments integration. This gives you a live store in hours. Then, add Cloudflare R2 for file delivery and Google Apps Script for automation. Finally, migrate to Supabase for order storage as your volume grows. Each step is independent but builds toward a complete stack.
Putting the List Into a Deployable Stack

Combine these elements into a single architecture: GitHub Pages for the frontend, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for data storage, and NOWPayments for crypto processing. Use USDT on Tron as your primary payment method. Deliver products via Cloudflare R2. Automate the entire flow with Google Apps Script webhooks. This stack removes all geographic and platform dependencies. You own every component. No subscriptions. No approvals. Deploy once—sell forever.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by deploying a sovereign commerce stack. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, NOWPayments for crypto processing, and Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Accept USDT on Tron for instant, low-cost transactions. This architecture bypasses geographic restrictions and eliminates platform dependencies. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates to implement this stack.
Cloudflare R2 delivers your products globally without bandwidth bills.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan face similar payment restrictions. The solutions outlined here apply equally to those regions. For a complete deployment guide, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. Build once—sell globally.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?
Yes. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes step-by-step blueprints and templates. No coding required.
What if a buyer doesn’t have crypto?
Direct them to Binance P2P to purchase USDT with local currency. Settles in under 60 seconds.
How do I handle chargebacks?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Use NOWPayments’ webhook to deliver products only after on-chain confirmation.
Is this legal in Ethiopia?
The stack uses globally accessible tools. Compliance depends on your product type—not the payment method.
Can I scale this to 1000+ sales/month?
Yes. Supabase and Cloudflare Workers scale automatically. Upgrade to Edge Commerce Stack for SPF/DKIM configuration.
Own the stack. Never rent infrastructure from platforms that reject you.
